jobs.name: creative-2-price-tag-v2
jobs.prompt:
Direct-response ad image for the Meta feed, 4:5. Build the ad around the two provided reference images: the man in the photo is the trainer (keep his face and appearance exactly as in the reference), and the horizontal logo is the brand mark (reproduce it exactly, never redraw it).

LAYOUT: the trainer stands on the right 45% of the frame, facing the camera with a warm confident smile, HOLDING a gift-card-sized voucher card face-out toward the viewer at chest height with both hands — he is presenting it, seller-to-buyer. Left of him, a large navy paper price tag hangs from a fine string from the top of frame. Headline in two lines across the top. Yellow CTA band below center-left, and a full-width navy footer bar at the very bottom. The brand logo sits small at top-left.

TYPE: headline in a heavy geometric sans, 800 weight, deep navy, sentence case, exactly: "Pay ₹589. Walk out with a ₹3,000 exam voucher." Under it one regular-weight line, exactly: "4-hour live PTE masterclass · templates for all 22 task types". On the hanging tag: "₹2,999" in cream struck through with one clean yellow line, and below it "₹589" at twice the size in warm yellow. On the voucher card he holds: gold foil border, the brand logo small at top, then "₹3,000 PTE EXAM VOUCHER" in embossed cream capitals with "included with your seat" smaller beneath. CTA band: rounded, solid warm yellow, navy bold text, exactly: "Claim your seat → ₹589". Footer bar: navy, cream uppercase, seat count in yellow, exactly: "SAT 11 JULY · 10 AM · 100 SEATS ONLY".

MATERIAL & LIGHT: warm champagne fabric backdrop with soft drapery folds, one directional key light from upper left creating gentle real shadows behind the trainer and under the hanging tag; the tag is textured matte paper with a brass eyelet and real string physics; the voucher card has a subtle gold-foil sheen catching the light. Rich, photographed, premium — a production shoot, not a flat layout.

PALETTE: warm champagne field, deep navy, warm yellow accents, gold foil details.

RENDER EXACTLY the quoted text strings and no other text, no watermarks. The trainer's face must match the reference photo exactly.

jobs.name: creative-3-apology-letter-v2
jobs.prompt:
Direct-response ad image for the Meta feed, 4:5. This image is a typeset newspaper-parody letter — typography with graphic drama is the entire creative. Reproduce the provided brand logo exactly where specified, never redraw it.

LAYOUT: at the top, a bold full-width banner: its left segment is warm yellow with diagonal navy caution stripes at its left edge and carries the word "BREAKING" in heavy navy capitals; the rest of the banner is deep navy carrying cream capitals, exactly: "PTE TRAINER ISSUES PUBLIC APOLOGY". Below the banner, the brand logo small and centered. Then a single centered letter column on off-white paper with a faint grain, generous margins, unhurried spacing between blocks. At the bottom, a full-width rounded yellow CTA band.

TYPE — set the letter in a classic serif with true italics, navy ink; every line break must fall at a phrase boundary, never mid-phrase; each checklist item stays on ONE line. The letter reads, exactly:
Opening line, italic: "Dear PTE aspirants, the industry owes you an apology."
Paragraph, one line: "You were told to improve your English. But you already:"
Three checklist lines, each with a bold yellow checkmark in a small navy square at line start, exactly: "speak fluent English" / "work in English every day" / "still score 55–65 in speaking"
Paragraph with bold emphasis, exactly: "Your English was never the problem. PTE is scored by a machine, and the machine rewards a format. Last batch, one student walked out with a 90/90 — the Pearson report is on our page." — set "never", "machine" (both times) and "90/90" in heavy bold at slightly larger size so they punch.
Sign-off, exactly: "This Saturday, I'll show you the format. All 22 task types. Four hours. — Parthasarathy Bhaskara, Pearson-certified trainer"
Italic P.S., exactly: "P.S. If you've booked a retake already — come before you sit it. The seat is ₹589; a retake is ₹18,000."
CTA band: solid warm yellow, navy bold sans, exactly: "Claim your seat → ₹589 · Sat 11 July"

FINISH: flat printed-artifact look with the banner giving it tabloid energy; subtle paper texture; the bold rhythm inside the paragraphs does the drama; no photography, no illustration.

PALETTE: off-white paper, navy ink, warm yellow banner segment, checkmarks and CTA band.

RENDER EXACTLY the quoted text strings and no other text, no watermarks.
